requirements.text: Each Business Day the system must value every FLEX Option position at the exchange model-based price at the official close, except where a same-day market trading price for that option exists, in which case the same-day trade price is used.
requirements.quote: FLEX Options listed on an exchange will typically be valued at a model-based price provided by the exchange at the official close of that exchange's trading day. However, when the Fund's option has a same-day market trading price, this same-day market trading price will be used for FLEX Option values instead of the exchange's model-based price.

requirements.text: If the exchange cannot provide a model price, the system must use the backup third-party pricing provider's model price; if neither vendor is available, use the value determined by the Valuation Designee per the Valuation Procedures.
requirements.quote: If the exchange on which the option is traded is unable to provide a model price, model-based FLEX Options prices will additionally be provided by a backup third-party pricing provider. If either pricing vendor is not available to provide a model price for that day, the value of a FLEX option will be determined by Innovator as Valuation Designee in accordance with the Valuation Procedures.

requirements.text: Purchased options must be carried as assets at current value; written options must be carried as a liability at current value, each adjusted daily to current value with the change recorded as unrealized gain/loss.
requirements.quote: When the Funds purchase an option, an amount equal to the premium paid by the Funds are recorded as an investment and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option purchased... When the Funds write an option, an amount equal to the premium received by the Funds are recorded as a liability and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option written.

requirements.text: Each day the system must accrue the unitary management fee at 0.79% annual on average daily net assets, as a reduction to net assets.
requirements.quote: the Fund has agreed to pay an annual unitary management fee to Innovator in an amount equal to 0.79% of its average daily net assets.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Day-count convention (e.g., 365 vs actual/actual, weekend accrual) must be confirmed; assumed calendar-day accrual at rate/365 per calendar day.

requirements.text: Each day the system must accrue interest on the cash held in the Money Market Deposit Account at the then-current variable rate.
requirements.quote: The MMDA will bear interest at a variable rate that is determined based on market conditions and is subject to change daily.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Day-count convention must be confirmed; assumed simple interest at rate/365 per calendar day.

requirements.text: The system must compute NAV per share each day the NYSE is open as total assets (including accrued interest/dividends) less all liabilities, divided by shares outstanding, rounded to the nearest cent.
requirements.quote: The NAV for one Share is the value of that Share's portion of the net assets of the Fund... less all liabilities, and dividing such amount by the total number of Shares outstanding. The result, rounded to the nearest cent is the NAV per Share.

requirements.text: On a closing transaction (buy-back of written / sale of purchased), the system must realize gain or loss: for written options the difference between premium received and amount paid including commission; for purchased options proceeds less cost including commission, using identified cost.
requirements.quote: The difference between the premium and the amount paid on effecting a closing purchase transaction, including brokerage commissions, is also treated as a realized gain... The Trust determines the gain or loss realized from investment transactions on the basis of identified cost.
requirements.assumption_or_question: For a partially-closed position opened in multiple lots, lot-relief method must be confirmed; assumed average cost within a single lot and identified cost across lots.

requirements.text: At the conclusion of the Outcome Period the system must settle all FLEX Options in cash at the difference between the reference closing price and strike times the multiplier (floored at zero for option holders / option writers as applicable), record the cash received/owed, and realize the gain or loss.
requirements.quote: Upon conclusion of the Outcome Period, the Fund will receive the cash value of all the FLEX Options it held for the prior Outcome Period... The amount of cash is equal to the difference between the closing price of the Reference Asset's price return and the exercise price of the option contract times a specified multiple ('multiplier').

requirements.text: The multiplier (shares per contract) must be applied to all option values and settlements; the system must use 100 shares per contract.
Options and investment transactions must be recorded on trade date.
requirements.quote: Investment transactions are recorded on the trade date.

requirements.text: Dividends on the reference must NOT be accrued as income to the Fund, because the Fund holds price-return FLEX Options and receives no dividends.
requirements.quote: the Cap and Buffer will be provided on a price return basis... and the Fund will not receive the benefit of any dividends.

requirements.text: On creations/redemptions the system must compute a Cash Component / Cash Redemption Amount equal to the difference between NAV per Creation Unit and the aggregate market value of the basket instruments, and apply the transaction fee per order.
requirements.quote: The Cash Component is an amount equal to the difference between the NAV of a Fund's shares (per Creation Unit) and the Deposit Amount... A transaction fee is applicable to each transaction regardless of the number of units.

requirements.text: When a FLEX Option appears the same trading day in both an all-cash basket and an in-kind basket, the system must value that option at the trade price for both instances rather than the model price.
requirements.quote: In instances where in the same trading day, a particular FLEX Option is represented in an all-cash basket... as well as in an in-kind basket..., for valuation purposes that trading day the Fund will default to use the trade price for both instances, rather than the model price otherwise available for the in-kind transaction.

requirements.text: The system must apply corporate-action adjustments (splits, etc.) on the reference by adjusting contract counts and strikes so that notional exposure is preserved, and must ensure the pricing feed and contract terms are consistent.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Documents do not describe how OCC/exchange adjusts FLEX contract terms on a reference split; assumed OCC standard adjustment doubling contracts and halving strike for a 2:1 split, preserving notional. Adjustment ratio and method must be confirmed with the clearing broker/OCC.

requirements.text: The threshold above which a NAV error must be corrected/reprocessed must be applied by the system.
requirements.assumption_or_question: The documents do not state a NAV error-correction threshold; the client's/administrator's NAV error policy (commonly 1/2 cent per share or $0.01, or a basis-point threshold) must be confirmed before build. No figure given.
